summary: Five-phase plan converting the unexplained strict xfail into a self-verifying record of a confirmed external BimodalHarness boundary-scan defect. No ModelChecker semantics change; MC is correct on all 12 disagreements.

artifacts.summary: Ground-truth evaluator promotion, solver-free disagreement classifier, xfail removal with five ordered loud-failure guards, upstream defect record, end-to-end verification.

memory_candidates.content: When a differential/cross-oracle test suite records a divergence caused by a defect in an EXTERNAL reference implementation, an xfail is the wrong mechanism: an xfail asserts the test is expected to fail, but once the divergence is attributed the test should pass. The durable pattern is instead an independent in-repo ground-truth adjudicator plus three-way bucketing of each disagreement (external-defect / own-defect / unadjudicable), guarded by ordered assertions: (1) a conclusive-count floor asserted FIRST so a starved solve budget is diagnosed as a performance regression rather than misread as an upstream fix, (2) own-defect empty, (3) unadjudicable empty so a new differently-shaped divergence cannot be absorbed, (4) external-defect bucket NON-empty as a staleness guard that fires when upstream fixes the defect and the accommodation becomes dead code, (5) per-entry verdict-signature match so a different external defect cannot hide inside the accommodation bucket. Adjudicating against a ground-truth evaluator generalizes strictly better than excluding a syntactic shape family, and turns 'our side is correct here' from a comment into a checked assertion. The adjudicator itself needs a stability test (verdict invariant as its search window widens) because a bounded brute-force evaluator is vulnerable to the same boundary-truncation artifact it exists to diagnose.
